title: Generative / diffusion / Sgen decision gate
decision_justification: On the non-circular benchmark-v2, the diffusion surprise Sgen scores BELOW chance (ROC-AUC 0.4868, CI [0.4633, 0.5109]), is near-constant (std 0.04), and anomalies score lower than normals (wrong direction). It does not correlate positively with S_ont (corr -0.07). Adding Sgen to the combined score HARMS it, statistically credibly (combined 0.6545 -> 0.637; paired diff -0.0175, CI [-0.0266, -0.0087], p~0). The generator is mode-collapsed (127/4587 unique tokens; generated length 254 vs real 47). Sgen is removed from the core method; w_gen stays 0.0.

generative_model_state.trained_on: old circular-era mimiciv_val.pkl (NOT benchmark-v2, NOT clean-normal-only)
generative_model_state.loads_into_current_code: only via a compatibility shim (architecture drift: module renames + time-embedding MLP width changed 128->512). Token/transformer/output weights load; the time-MLP cannot.

generative_eval_benchmark_v2.note: DIAGNOSTIC-only (old-data, mode-collapsed checkpoint via compat shim); not paper evidence.

scoring_defaults.sgen_status: diagnostic/appendix-only; only enters S_cal if an s_gen is supplied AND w_gen>0 (never by default)

minimal_repair_done: compatibility-shim checkpoint loader (key remap + skip drifted time-MLP) + deterministic multi-noise-sample scoring + min-max normalization. NO retraining, NO architecture redesign.
code_disposition: diffusion/generative code retained but NOT in the core scoring path; isolated as diagnostic/legacy. No deletion (Phase-2/3 tests still exercise the model module).

claim_impact.C7_sgen_separates_anomalies: remains cut_unless_fixed -> now CONFIRMED removed from core: Sgen below chance on benchmark-v2 and harms the combined score. Reframe as future work / negative result.
claim_impact.C8_diffusion_realistic_generation: remains cut_unless_fixed: severe mode collapse (127/4587 tokens). Future work (discrete/latent diffusion) or cut.

next_step: Phase 6 (full-scale training + experiment infrastructure) MAY proceed WITHOUT Sgen in the core method. Generative retraining (benchmark-v2 clean-normal-only + anti-collapse) is a separate optional future phase; only revisit Sgen if it later passes the gate. Do NOT move to H200 unless Phase 6 explicitly requires it.
